agents.name: scout
agents.title: Scout — Agent R&D
agents.description: SCOUT — THE R&D AGENT THAT WATCHES ALL THE OTHER AGENTS AND TELLS YOU HOW TO MAKE THEM BETTER. Twice a day it reviews every registered agent, recent run logs, and recent agent-master commits, then surfaces: (1) CROSS-AGENT LEARNINGS — a capability one agent has that another should adopt, (2) concrete improvements + new functions/features to add, (3) errors and expired-auth warnings buried in the logs, (4) new tools / APIs / models worth exploring. Everything accumulates in LEARNINGS.md so the network compounds over time. ADVISORY ONLY — it never edits other agents; a human reviews + applies. payload.action `report` = research + EMAIL the report; `research` = research + append to LEARNINGS.md without emailing. Auto-runs 6 AM + 6 PM via launchd (the morning run emails).
